description: Land Aquisition - Uppuweli, Town and Gravets  D/S Division, Trincomalee District.
categorisation: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing the acquisition of a specific land parcel (1.4431 hectares in Trincomalee) for public purpose. It contains detailed land description, boundaries, and procedures for compensation claims, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) dealing with land acquisitions and property matters.
